confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Santa Marta price indexes. The food and drink anchors come from cost-of-living aggregators, which vary by source and year. I found no cocktail prices, so the cocktail anchor is about 3.5 times the beer price. The wine glass is estimated from a mid-range bottle price of about $11. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. The FX rate is the RBA figure dated 18 November 2026. A 19 November value of 0.6677 appeared in the search results but I could not confirm it as final.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to Caribbean-coast Colombian tourist cities such as Cartagena, which is somewhat pricier, and to the Colombian national average. Santa Marta is slightly cheaper than Cartagena, with tourist-area price premiums in El Rodadero and Taganga.
